# DotGame.AudioCodecs

Opus, FLAC and WAV audio codecs, with no dependencies: a decoder and an encoder for each.

[Documentation](../README.md)

## DotGame.AudioCodecs

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [AudioDecoder](AudioDecoder.md) | class | Decodes an audio file in chunks: each [`Read`](AudioDecoder.md#read) fills the caller's buffer with the next frames, interleaved, and [`Seek`](AudioDecoder.md#seek) moves to any frame. |
| [AudioDecoderOptions](AudioDecoderOptions.md) | class | The settings of a [`FlacDecoder`](FlacDecoder.md) or [`OpusDecoder`](OpusDecoder.md) (WAV has none). |
| [AudioEncoder](AudioEncoder.md) | class | Encodes an audio file in chunks: each [`Write`](AudioEncoder.md#write) adds frames, and [`Complete`](AudioEncoder.md#complete) finishes the file. |

## DotGame.AudioCodecs.Flac

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [FlacDecoder](FlacDecoder.md) | class | Decodes FLAC files (RFC 9639): 1 to 8 channels of 4 to 32-bit samples, every frame and subframe type, checking each frame's CRC-8 and CRC-16. |
| [FlacEncoder](FlacEncoder.md) | class | Encodes FLAC files (RFC 9639): 1 to 8 channels of 4 to 24-bit samples at 1 Hz to 1,048,575 Hz, with flac's settings and defaults ([`FlacEncoderOptions`](FlacEncoderOptions.md)). |
| [FlacEncoderOptions](FlacEncoderOptions.md) | class | The settings of a [`FlacEncoder`](FlacEncoder.md): flac's, with its defaults, so setting nothing writes a file laid out as `flac` writes one with no options. |

## DotGame.AudioCodecs.Opus

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [OpusApplication](OpusApplication.md) | enum | What an Opus encoder is tuned for. |
| [OpusBandwidth](OpusBandwidth.md) | enum | An Opus audio bandwidth. |
| [OpusBitrateMode](OpusBitrateMode.md) | enum | How an Opus encoder holds its bitrate. |
| [OpusDecoder](OpusDecoder.md) | class | Decodes Ogg Opus files (RFC 7845): 1 to 8 channels (channel mapping families 0 and 1), always at 48 kHz, with libopus 1.6.1's decoder, its fixed-point build, sample for sample. |
| [OpusEncoder](OpusEncoder.md) | class | Encodes Ogg Opus files (RFC 7845) with libopus 1.6.1's encoder, its fixed-point build, packet for packet: 1 to 8 channels (mapping family 0 for one or two, family 1 above, as opusenc), from input at any rate. |
| [OpusEncoderOptions](OpusEncoderOptions.md) | class | The settings of an [`OpusEncoder`](OpusEncoder.md): libopus's, with opusenc's defaults, so setting nothing encodes as `opusenc` does with no options. |
| [OpusFileOptions](OpusFileOptions.md) | class | The settings of an Ogg Opus file that aren't the encoder's. |
| [OpusFrameDuration](OpusFrameDuration.md) | enum | The duration of an Opus packet. |
| [OpusSignal](OpusSignal.md) | enum | A hint of what an Opus encoder's signal is. |

## DotGame.AudioCodecs.Wav

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [WavDecoder](WavDecoder.md) | class | Decodes WAV files: 8, 16, 24 and 32-bit integer and 32 and 64-bit float samples, 1 to 8 channels, in the plain and WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE forms. |
| [WavEncoder](WavEncoder.md) | class | Encodes WAV files: 8, 16, 24 and 32-bit integer or 32 and 64-bit float samples ([`WavEncoderOptions.SampleFormat`](WavEncoderOptions.md#sampleformat)), 1 to 8 channels, at any rate. |
| [WavEncoderOptions](WavEncoderOptions.md) | class | The settings of a [`WavEncoder`](WavEncoder.md). |
| [WavSampleFormat](WavSampleFormat.md) | enum | How a WAV file stores its samples. |
